chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abi Basir, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:

Whoever strikes his owned slave with one of the prescribed punishments, without there being a prescribed punishment due from the slave to Allah, then there is no expiation for the one who struck him except to set him free.
ai.seo_question: What is the expiation for someone who unjustly strikes his slave with a hadd punishment?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning unjustly punishing a mamluk with a hadd punishment when no such hadd is due upon him before Allah. It establishes that the expiation for such an act is only the slave’s manumission, underscoring the gravity of oppression and wrongful punishment.
